lines: - Barris: "HEY. Get over here you dumb beast. No, here. No. Come... ahhhh."
- Barris: "YOU WANT TO GET EATEN. FINE. WALK AWAY. SEE IF I CARE."
- Barris: "Barris, herd the Tamms. Barris, the Tamms have wandered off again. Barris, why aren't you watching the Tamms. Ugh... I never asked be a stupid shepherd."
- Barris: "HEY! Do you want to fall into the sky??? Wish you would, you straw-brained Tamm. UGHGH."
- Barris: "UGH. Stupid Tamms are out again. They won't come when called but I'm the one who gets in trouble when they get lost."
- Barris: "Being a shepherd is so... dumb. I'm no good at this. Why do I have to do this dumb job anyway? "
- Barris: "Are they trying to get themselves eaten by Krubies?"
- Barris: "Think they'll listen to you??? Love to see that."
- Barris: "Go ahead, but I don't even think Brimon could get those Tamms back into their pen."
- Barris: "Get them back into the pen... PLEASE."
- Barris: "That was one of the smart ones."
- Barris: "Gee... You're kinda good at this."
- Barris: "Woah. How did you get them to follow you?"
- Barris: "What did you say to them?"
- Barris: "Okay. I'll try to do it just like you next time. Thanks!"
- Barris: "Hey, hey! Where you going? You're no better than the stupid Tamms."
- Barris: "What? So you're going to wander away too? Just my luck."
